title: Ringo Starr attends Son Of Dracula premiere | 1974
content:
Ringo Starr attended the premiere of the film Son Of Dracula on 19 April 1974.

The musical starred Harry Nilsson as Count Downe and Starr as Merlin. It was directed by Freddie Francis.

The premiere was held at the Cherokee Theatre in Atlanta, Georgia, USA.
